name: Phillip Lavien
source:
[i]"I'm glad to have such adorable juniors. Feel free to rely on me if you ever need anything."[/i]

[i]Compassionate Prince[/i]

A Sylphid who reaches out to those weaker than him like a gentle prince. He's often with Barrett, either consoling him when he's angry or teasing him just for fun.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=phillip]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
